info.title: Upload-Post API
info.description: Upload-Post is a unified social media API that allows you to upload videos, photos, text, and documents to 22 social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X/Twitter, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, Telegram, WordPress and more) with a single API call. Features include scheduling, queue system, async uploads, FFmpeg media processing, analytics, webhooks, and white-label user management.

tags.name: Telegram
tags.description: Telegram through your own bot: chat data and analytics, Stars and payments, chat management, bot profile, commands and sticker sets, updates and direct messages.

tags.name: Content Upload
tags.description: Upload video, photo, text, and document content to social media platforms.

tags.name: Upload Management
tags.description: Check upload status, view history, and manage scheduled posts.

tags.name: Queue System
tags.description: Configure and preview the automatic post queue.

tags.name: Platform Integration
tags.description: Retrieve platform-specific data: Facebook pages, LinkedIn pages, Pinterest boards, Reddit posts, and analytics.

tags.name: User Management
tags.description: Create, list, get, and delete user profiles.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Verify API keys, generate and validate JWT tokens for white-label integration.

tags.name: FFmpeg Editor
tags.description: Process and transform media using FFmpeg commands on Upload-Post infrastructure.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Configure real-time webhook and Telegram notifications for upload events.

tags.name: Instagram Interactions
tags.description: Retrieve Instagram media, comments, conversations, and send direct messages or private replies.

tags.name: Bluesky
tags.description: Bluesky reads (read-only XRPC gateway, post engagement, profiles, search, followers) and notifications; actions, profile, graph, moderation and drafts. Likes, reposts, follows and list additions share daily limits per Bluesky account (200), per Upload-Post account and app-wide (Bluesky Developer Guidelines); reports, 20 per account per day. Repeating the same action within a short window returns the first answer (replayed: true).

tags.name: Teams and Approvals
tags.description: Team roles, post approval queue, end-client approval and the team activity log. Members call the API with their own credentials plus `X-Act-As-User: <owner email>`.

tags.name: Feedback
tags.description: Report an unclear error, a doc that does not match, a bug or a missing feature to the Upload-Post team.

tags.name: Google Business
tags.description: Google Business Profile: locations, reviews, posts, media, verification, attributes, menus, services, lodging, place actions, performance and account administration. Some writes are switched off or need confirm: true (see each operation).

tags.name: ChatGPT Ads
tags.description: Ads in ChatGPT through the customer's own OpenAI ad account: accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, creatives, insights and one-call promote.

post.description: Upload a video to one or more social media platforms. Supports TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, and Telegram. Supports immediate, async, scheduled, and queued uploads.

paid_partnership.description: [All] Marks the post as sponsored / paid partnership. Mapped to TikTok brand_content_toggle, YouTube hasPaidProductPlacement and X paid_partnership; Facebook and Pinterest also need the sponsor id. Networks without a native label publish without it and get a warning. Network-specific fields win. On TikTok it is not allowed with privacy_level=SELF_ONLY (400 commercial_disclosure_privacy_conflict) and drafts do not carry it. See https://docs.upload-post.com/guides/paid-partnership

x_paid_partnership.description: [X] Paid partnership disclosure on the first post. Wins over paid_partnership.

facebook_sponsor_id.description: [Facebook] Sponsor's Page id for the branded content tag (sponsor_id). Page photos, Page videos (facebook_media_type=VIDEO) and text posts; not Reels or Stories.

pinterest_sponsor_id.description: [Pinterest] Sponsor account id for the paid partnership label (sponsor_id). Pinterest closed beta only.

disclose_commercial.description: [TikTok] Disclose post content switch. With true, send your_brand and/or branded_content.

your_brand.description: [TikTok] With disclose_commercial: promoting your own business.

branded_content.description: [TikTok] With disclose_commercial: paid partnership with a third-party brand. With privacy_level=SELF_ONLY the post is published as PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE.

video.description: The video file to upload (binary file) or a public video URL.

title.description: Default title/caption of the video. Required for YouTube and Reddit; optional for all other platforms. Platform-specific titles override this.

description.description: Optional extended text used on LinkedIn commentary, Facebook descriptions, YouTube descriptions, and Pinterest notes. Ignored elsewhere.

scheduled_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time to schedule publishing (e.g., '2025-12-31T23:45:00Z'). Must be in the future (≤365 days). Omit for immediate upload. Cannot be used with `add_to_queue`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid', 'America/New_York'). If provided, `scheduled_date` is interpreted in this timezone. Defaults to UTC.

async_upload.description: If true, returns immediately with a `request_id` and processes in the background. If false but upload takes >59s, automatically switches to async.

add_to_queue.description: If true, automatically schedules the post to the next available queue slot. Cannot be used with `scheduled_date`.

first_comment.description: Automatically post a first comment after publishing. Supported on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Reddit, X, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

first_comment_media[].description: Image files to attach to the first comment as inline images. Currently supported on Reddit. Not available for scheduled or queued posts.

facebook_title.description: [Facebook] Specific title. Fallbacks to `title`. Ignored if facebook_media_type is STORIES.

threads_topic_tag.description: [Threads] A topic tag for the post (1-50 characters). Cannot contain periods (.) or ampersands (&). One tag per post.

bluesky_tags.description: [Bluesky] Up to 8 extra hashtags stored on the post without appearing in the text (comma list or JSON array; leading # optional; 64 characters each). More than 8, like any invalid new Bluesky field, fails only the Bluesky result (results.bluesky.success=false, error_code bluesky_invalid_parameter; HTTP 200).

bluesky_created_at.description: [Bluesky] Date the post is shown and sorted by (ISO 8601 with timezone, not in the future; 2 minutes of clock skew allowed). Default: now.

bluesky_thread_overflow.description: [Bluesky] Text longer than one post (300 characters): publish the rest as replies under the media post (adds thread_count). Without it the text is cut and a warning is returned.

bluesky_captions.description: [Bluesky] JSON array of up to 20 subtitle tracks, one per language: [{"lang":"es","url":"https://.../es.vtt"}] or [{"lang":"en","vtt":"WEBVTT..."}]. WebVTT, at most 20,000 bytes each.

bluesky_video_presentation.description: [Bluesky] How the video is presented: default, or gif (looping, muted, no controls).

cover_timestamp.description: [TikTok] Timestamp in milliseconds for video cover.

brand_content_toggle.description: [TikTok] Set to true for paid partnerships promoting third-party brands.

brand_organic_toggle.description: [TikTok] Set to true when promoting the creator's own business.

share_to_feed.description: [Instagram] Whether to share to feed (only for regular Reels, not Trial Reels).

collaborators.description: [Instagram] Comma-separated list of collaborator usernames. Not available for Trial Reels.

cover_url.description: [Instagram] URL for custom video cover. Alternative to cover_image binary upload.

cover_image.description: [Instagram] Binary cover image for Reels (JPEG, max 8MB). If both cover_image and cover_url are provided, cover_url takes precedence.

audio_name.description: [Instagram] Name of the audio track embedded in your video (Reels only).

location_id.description: [Instagram] Instagram location ID.

is_ai_generated.description: Cross-platform AI-disclosure flag. Set to `true` to self-disclose the content as AI-generated. On Instagram (Reels, photos, carousels) it is forwarded as Meta's `is_ai_generated` and shows the "AI info" label under the account name; the label cannot be added or removed after publishing. On TikTok it maps to `is_aigc`, on YouTube to `containsSyntheticMedia` and on X to `made_with_ai`; a platform-specific value takes precedence over this alias. See the AI Content Labeling guide.

linkedin_description.description: [LinkedIn] Sent as the LinkedIn commentary. If omitted, reuses `title`.

target_linkedin_page_id.description: [LinkedIn] LinkedIn page ID to upload to an organization page.

thumbnail.description: [YouTube] Custom thumbnail image file (JPG/PNG/GIF/BMP, max 50MB). On Shorts it is set once YouTube finishes processing.

thumbnail_url.description: [YouTube] Alternative: provide thumbnail as a public URL.

containsSyntheticMedia.description: [YouTube] Declaration that video contains AI-generated content.

defaultLanguage.description: [YouTube] Language of title and description (BCP-47 code, e.g., 'es', 'en').

defaultAudioLanguage.description: [YouTube] Language of the video audio (BCP-47 code, e.g., 'es-ES', 'en-US').

allowedCountries.description: [YouTube] Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the video is allowed. Cannot be used with `blockedCountries`. YouTube ignores it on API uploads (not saved); use YouTube Studio.

blockedCountries.description: [YouTube] Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the video is blocked. Cannot be used with `allowedCountries`. YouTube ignores it on API uploads (not saved); use YouTube Studio.

hasPaidProductPlacement.description: [YouTube] Paid product placement / sponsorship declaration (paidProductPlacementDetails). Also set by paid_partnership. If YouTube answers it as false the YouTube result carries a warning.

youtube_localizations.description: [YouTube] JSON object with the translated title and description per BCP-47 language, e.g. {"es": {"title": "...", "description": "..."}}. Requires `defaultLanguage`. Ignored with a warning if YouTube management features are temporarily off.

youtube_brand_partner.description: [YouTube] Brand partner for creator-initiated brand partner access: channel ID (UC..., 24 characters). Handles are not accepted. Ignored with a warning if YouTube management features are temporarily off.

facebook_page_id.description: [Facebook] Facebook Page ID where the video will be posted. Required for Facebook. Auto-detected if only one page is connected.

facebook_description.description: [Facebook] Sent as video description. Ignored for STORIES.

x_long_text_as_post.description: [X] When true, publishes long text as a single post instead of a thread.

nullcast.description: [X] Whether to publish without broadcasting (promoted-only posts).

community_id.description: [X] Community ID for posting to specific communities.

direct_message_deep_link.description: [X] Link to take conversation to private Direct Message.

tagged_user_ids.description: [X] Array of user IDs to tag in the media (max 10).

reply_to_id.description: [X] ID of the tweet to reply to.

exclude_reply_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to exclude from replying. Requires `reply_to_id`.

pinterest_board_id.description: [Pinterest] Pinterest board ID to publish to. Required when platform includes pinterest.

pinterest_link.description: [Pinterest] Destination link for the video Pin.

pinterest_cover_image_url.description: [Pinterest] URL of an image to use as the video cover.

pinterest_cover_image_content_type.description: [Pinterest] Content type of the cover image (e.g., image/jpeg).

pinterest_cover_image_key_frame_time.description: [Pinterest] Time in milliseconds of the video frame to use as cover.

subreddit.description: [Reddit] Name of the subreddit (without 'r/'). Required when platform includes reddit.

flair_id.description: [Reddit] ID of the flair to apply to the post.

telegram_message_thread_id.description: Telegram: forum topic to post in.

telegram_direct_messages_topic_id.description: Telegram: topic of a channel direct messages chat.

telegram_reply_markup.description: Telegram: InlineKeyboardMarkup JSON with URL buttons.

telegram_reply_to_message_id.description: Telegram: publish as a reply to this message.

telegram_reply_quote.description: Telegram: exact part of the replied message to quote (max 1024).

telegram_reply_parameters.description: Telegram: full ReplyParameters JSON (instead of reply_to_message_id/reply_quote).

telegram_pin.description: Telegram: pin the post after publishing.

telegram_first_comment_as_reply.description: Telegram: first comment as a reply to the post (default true).

telegram_suggested_post_parameters.description: Telegram: SuggestedPostParameters JSON (channel direct messages chats only; a price is not available for now).

telegram_allow_paid_broadcast.description: Telegram: it can spend your bot's Stars. Paid broadcasts charge 0.1 Telegram Stars per message above the free 30 messages/s, from the bot's balance.

telegram_pin_notify.description: Telegram: with telegram_pin, notify group members about the pin (pinning is silent by default; Telegram never notifies a pin in channels or private chats).

telegram_caption_entities.description: Telegram: MessageEntity JSON array for the caption, instead of telegram_parse_mode.

telegram_has_spoiler.description: Telegram: cover the media with a spoiler.

telegram_show_caption_above_media.description: Telegram: show the caption above the media.

telegram_caption_overflow.description: Telegram: caption over 1024 characters: truncate (default, the request is refused with 400) or split (the rest goes as a reply).

telegram_send_by_url.description: Telegram: let Telegram download the URL itself (5 MB photos, 20 MB other files).

telegram_paid_star_count.description: Telegram: paid media price in Telegram Stars (1-25000), paid by the reader.

telegram_paid_payload.description: Telegram: internal reference of the paid media (max 128 bytes).

telegram_send_as.description: Telegram: send the video as animation, video_note, live_photo or document.

telegram_cover.description: Telegram: video cover (public URL or file_id).

telegram_thumbnail.description: Telegram: thumbnail URL (JPEG, under 200 kB, max 320x320).

telegram_media_urls.description: Telegram: comma-separated photo/video URLs (max 9) sent with the video as one album.

telegram_live_photo_photo.description: Telegram: still photo URL of a live photo.

telegram_send_title.description: Telegram: send the text before a video note (default true).

200.description: Upload completed synchronously or async processing started.

202.description:
Post scheduled or queued successfully.

Or: Not generally available yet (team roles and post approvals). The caller is an Editor or Contributor team member: the post is NOT published or scheduled; it waits for review (pending_approval) or stays as a draft. Track it with approval_id (`/uploadposts/approvals/{approval_id}`) or with GET /uploadposts/status?request_id=.

Retrieve analytics data for a user profile across one or more social media platforms. Returns metrics like followers, views, impressions, reach, and time series data. Note: Instagram's API renamed 'impressions' to 'views'; both fields are returned for compatibility.

parameters.description: The unique username of the profile.

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of platforms: instagram, tiktok, linkedin, facebook, x, youtube, threads, pinterest, reddit, bluesky.

parameters.description: Required for Facebook analytics. The Facebook Page ID.

parameters.description: LinkedIn only. Organization/company page URN or numeric ID to fetch analytics for. LinkedIn analytics are available only for organization/company pages you administer — personal profiles are not supported, because LinkedIn's API does not expose member-level analytics. If omitted, the first administered organization page is used.

200.description: Analytics data retrieved successfully. Response keys are platform names with platform-specific metrics.

get.description: Replays per-post metrics that Upload-Post already fetched, instead of calling the social platforms again. Because it never touches the platforms during the request, it is NOT subject to the platform analytics rate limit of 100 requests / 5 minutes that applies to the live /uploadposts/post-analytics endpoints, and it is paginated — built for re-reading a large back catalogue. IMPORTANT: this is a write-through cache filled as a side effect of live reads. A post appears here only after it has been fetched at least once through a live per-post endpoint, and there is no background refresh — captured_at is the last time that post was read live. To refresh a post, call the live endpoint for it.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The profile_username of the profile to read snapshots for.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Restrict the result to a single platform. When omitted, all platforms are returned and the response echoes platform: null.

parameters.description: Number of posts per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 200.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page token. Pass back exactly the value returned in next_cursor by the previous response. An invalid cursor returns 400.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Start of the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: End of the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

platform.description: The platform filter applied, or null when none was requested.

source.description: Always 'snapshot_cache' — a marker that these numbers came from the daily snapshot, not a live platform call.

post_id.description: The post's native ID on the platform.

date.description: Snapshot date this row belongs to.

captured_at.description: The last time this post was fetched live from the platform. Use it to judge freshness; nothing refreshes it in the background.

metrics.description: Metrics captured for this post. Keys vary per platform (e.g. YouTube returns views, likes, comments, favorites; TikTok adds reach, favorites, new_followers, profile_views, full_video_watched_rate, average_time_watched, total_time_watched, is_ai_generated, the per-second retention curve, impression_sources and audience_types). What the platform did not report is omitted, never zeroed. Read the keys present rather than assuming a fixed schema.

next_cursor.description: Token to pass as 'cursor' on the next request. Null when there are no more pages.

400.description: Missing user, invalid platform, malformed since/until date, or an invalid cursor.

get.description: Who follows a connected account, when they are online, what they tap on the profile and how it compares to its category. One endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`, exactly like /uploadposts/comments and /uploadposts/post-analytics — never one URL per network. Only `tiktok` answers today; any other value returns 400 with error_code `platform_not_supported` and a message naming the supported ones. `activity_by_hour` (24 entries, followers online per hour, summed over the window) is the field to build a publishing schedule on. The window is trimmed to what the platform accepts — at most 60 days, always ending before today — so read the `range` that comes back, not the one you sent. Requires the `profile_analytics` capability.

get.description: The best hours to publish for a connected account on one network, in the requested timezone. One endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`. Every answer carries `source` (audience_activity: the network reports followers online per hour, TikTok Business and Instagram 100+ followers; account_posts: the account's recent posts vs its median post, needs 10+ posts; upload_post_history: posts published through Upload-Post whose analytics were read, the only source for X and personal LinkedIn profiles; none: no data yet, best_times empty) and `confidence` (high/medium/low/null). YouTube uses the Data API, not Analytics (no hour dimension). Facebook's page_fans_online was deprecated by Meta, so Facebook is post-based. On networks whose quota is shared with publishing (YouTube, Reddit, LinkedIn, Pinterest) best times have their own daily budget; when it or the network quota runs out, the answer uses only data already stored and says so in `warnings`. Cached 24 h (7 days for YouTube and X), in UTC, so another `timezone` costs no call.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone of the hours returned. Default: the profile's queue timezone, else UTC.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Recompute instead of using the cache, only if the cached answer is at least 24 h old (YouTube and X: 7 days).

parameters.name: facebook_page_id
parameters.description: Facebook only: numeric id of one of the connection's Pages (a Page pinned to the profile wins). Ignored on other networks.

score.description: 0-1 relative to the best hour; null when nothing is known about that hour.

relative_engagement.description: Post-based sources: 1.0 = the account's median post.

posts.description: Post-based sources: posts published at that hour.

score.description: 0-1 relative to the best hour; null when nothing is known about that hour.

relative_engagement.description: Post-based sources: 1.0 = the account's median post.

post.description: Submit a media processing job using an FFmpeg command template. Supports single or multiple input files via multipart upload or JSON with URLs. Jobs are asynchronous — poll the status endpoint until finished.

file.description: Primary media file to process. Referenced as {input} or {input0}.

full_command.description: FFmpeg command template using {input}/{input0}, {input1}, etc. and {output} placeholders. Example: 'ffmpeg -y -i {input} -c:v libx264 -crf 23 {output}'. Every -i must be an uploaded input ({input}/{inputN}) or a '-f lavfi' source; {output} is the only output. No protocols or URLs, no movie=/amovie=/sendcmd/zmq, no absolute paths except fonts under /usr/share/fonts/, no '..', no -safe 0. -stream_loop -1, -loop 1 or a lavfi source without a duration need -t, -shortest or -frames; -stream_loop goes from -1 to 100. The job is charged max(input duration, output duration).

files.description: Array of input file URLs. Referenced as {input0}, {input1}, etc.

full_command.description: FFmpeg command template using {input0}, {input1}, etc. and {output} placeholders.

job_id.description: Unique job identifier for polling status.

get.description: Poll the status of an FFmpeg processing job. Statuses: PENDING, PROCESSING, FINISHED, ERROR.
Download the processed file when job status is FINISHED. Returns binary media with appropriate Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers.
Check your current FFmpeg usage, remaining quota, and processing history for the current month.

get.description: Retrieve a list of recent media (posts, reels, videos, pins, tweets, etc.) from a connected social media account. Supports Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and Reddit.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: The platform to retrieve media from.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

parameters.name: page_urn
parameters.description: LinkedIn only. Selects which LinkedIn page to fetch posts from. Accepts a numeric organization ID (e.g., 12345), a full URN (e.g., urn:li:organization:12345), or 'me' to force the connected member's personal profile. If omitted, accounts connected as an organization admin auto-resolve to their first administered organization; otherwise the personal profile is used.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of media items to return. Defaults to 25 and is clamped to 1-100, then capped again by the platform's own maximum page size: Instagram/Facebook/Threads/Bluesky/X/Pinterest/Reddit/LinkedIn 100, YouTube 50, TikTok 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page token. Pass back exactly the value returned in pagination.next_cursor by the previous response. Not supported on LinkedIn, Discord and Telegram: sending a cursor for those platforms returns 400 with a message naming the platform.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Bluesky only. Which posts to list (Bluesky's author feed filter).

parameters.name: include_pins
parameters.description: Bluesky only. true puts the pinned post first, with pinned: true.

id.description: Platform-specific unique identifier for the media item.

caption.description: Text content, caption, or title of the post.

media_url.description: Direct URL to the media file (image or video). Available on most platforms. Returns null for TikTok, YouTube, and when the platform does not provide a direct media URL. URLs are temporary and may expire.

permalink.description: Direct URL to the post on the platform.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was created.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the thumbnail or preview image.

post_id.description: Bluesky: the post's at:// URI, always present (id stays the cid).

pinned.description: Bluesky: always present; true for the pinned post (include_pins=true).

pagination.description: Page metadata. Additive: every pre-existing response key is unchanged.

limit.description: The effective limit applied after clamping and per-platform capping.

next_cursor.description: Token to pass as 'cursor' on the next request. Null on the last page.

has_more.description: True when another page is available.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters, platform account not linked, or a cursor was supplied for LinkedIn, Discord or Telegram (which do not support cursors). Bluesky: error_code `bluesky_invalid_parameter` for a wrong filter or include_pins.

get.description: List comments on one of your posts. Supported platforms: Instagram, Facebook, YouTube (account must be connected with the youtube.force-ssl scope), LinkedIn (organization posts) and TikTok. For YouTube, post_id is the video ID; for LinkedIn, post_id is the post URN (e.g. urn:li:ugcPost:123); for TikTok, post_id is the video id. Instagram comments are returned newest-first per Meta Graph API v3.2+. Pass comment_id to get the replies under one comment instead of the post's top-level comments (TikTok, Threads, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn company Pages). TikTok requires the `comments` capability — TikTok grants comment permission only at the moment the account is connected, so an account connected earlier must be reconnected from Manage Users or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. On TikTok, post_url accepts a tiktok.com/@user/video/<id> URL. Successful responses are cached for 60 seconds per account and query string; any comment write made through Upload-Post by the same account clears that cache. On X the mentions page behind the listing is also kept for 120 seconds per X account. Bluesky: without depth, parent_height or comment_id the listing is unchanged (same fields as before). With any of them it returns the thread view in one call (no pagination, limit caps top-level replies): depth nests replies in `replies`, parent_height returns the posts above in `parents`, comment_id (a reply's at:// URI) returns the replies to that reply; post_id/post_url/comment_id then also accept a bsky.app link, each comment adds parent_id, quote_count and hidden (hidden by the author with thread controls) and the response adds hidden_replies. Both need the Bluesky account connected.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform to list comments from. Reddit answers 503 reddit_unavailable.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

parameters.name: post_id
parameters.description: Post identifier. YouTube = the video ID; LinkedIn = the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...); Instagram = numeric media ID. Use post_id or post_url (one is required).

parameters.name: post_url
parameters.description: Full post URL. Alternative to post_id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum comments to return per page. LinkedIn's top-level listing ignores it (LinkedIn's first page, no pagination); LinkedIn replies apply it.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned in `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous response. Pass it back to fetch the next page. Named `after` on this endpoint (`cursor` is ignored here). On LinkedIn replies it is a number.

parameters.name: comment_id
parameters.description: TikTok, Threads, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Bluesky (the reply's at:// URI or bsky.app link; turns on the thread view). Returns the replies hanging off this comment instead of the post's top-level comments - the same question narrowed to a parent, not a separate URL, with the same pagination. post_id is still required. On LinkedIn it can be the comment_urn from the listing; a bare id is looked up among the post's first 250 comments (404 `linkedin_comment_not_found` otherwise). LinkedIn replies are readable on company Page posts only: 403 `linkedin_personal_not_supported` for a personal-profile connection, 403 `linkedin_page_access_denied` when LinkedIn refuses a Page connection (admin role lost). A comment_id in the wrong format answers 400 `invalid_comment_id`; one Instagram or Facebook does not know answers 404 `comment_not_found` (a comment without replies is a 200 with an empty list; on LinkedIn an unknown comment_urn is also an empty 200). On Facebook post_id is still required: it picks the Page whose token reads the comment. Other platforms answer 400 `platform_not_supported`. TikTok indexes a newly created comment asynchronously: listing within ~10 seconds of writing one returns a list without it.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Bluesky only, turns on the thread view. Levels of nested replies (each comment's `replies`).

parameters.name: parent_height
parameters.description: Bluesky only, turns on the thread view. Posts above post_id to return in `parents`.

parent_id.description: Bluesky thread view: at:// URI of the reply it answers; null when it answers the post.

hidden.description: Bluesky thread view: hidden by the post's author (thread controls).

replies.description: Bluesky thread view: nested replies, same fields, down to `depth`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `after` for the next page. Null on the last page.

has_next.description: True if more pages are available.

hidden_replies.description: Bluesky thread view: at:// URIs of the replies hidden by the author.

parents.description: Bluesky thread view, with parent_height: the posts above post_id, nearest first.

400.description: Missing parameters, invalid post identifier, limit outside 1-50, or an unsupported platform. error_code `invalid_comment_id` (comment_id in the wrong format), `invalid_cursor` (LinkedIn replies: after is not the number from next_cursor), `platform_not_supported` (comment_id on a platform without replies). TikTok: error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required` (reconnect the account) or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002: the request itself is wrong, e.g. a post_id that is not one of the account's videos; do not retry it).

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope (e.g. YouTube not connected with youtube.force-ssl). LinkedIn replies (comment_id): error_code `linkedin_personal_not_supported` (personal-profile connection) or `linkedin_page_access_denied` (Page connection LinkedIn refused); the top-level LinkedIn listing passes LinkedIn's own 403 through. Bluesky thread view: error_code `bluesky_blocked` (a block between the account and the post's author).

404.description: error_code `comment_not_found` (Instagram/Facebook do not know the comment_id) or `linkedin_comment_not_found` (a bare LinkedIn comment_id not among the post's first 250 comments; pass the comment_urn). Bluesky thread view: error_code `bluesky_not_found` (Bluesky cannot find the post or reply).

post.description: Post a comment or reply on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn or TikTok. Provide exactly one of comment_id (reply to that comment), post_id or post_url (top-level comment). Instagram supports replies only, so comment_id is required. For LinkedIn, post_id is the post URN. On TikTok, post_id (the video id) is always required — adding comment_id on top of it turns the call into a reply — and the connection must report the `comments` capability, i.e. a reconnected account, or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. On X, links in message are removed unless the X Links add-on is active (a `warnings` array says so; a message made only of links answers 400 `x_links_not_allowed`), and replies, edits and reposts share a daily cap per X account (20 on the Free plan, 200 on paid plans, per UTC day; 429 `x_daily_write_limit` with a Retry-After header).

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

message.description: The comment text. On X, links are removed unless the X Links add-on is active.

comment_id.description: Reply to this comment. Required for Instagram. Provide exactly one of comment_id, post_id or post_url.

post_id.description: Top-level comment on this post. LinkedIn = post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...); YouTube = video ID.

post_url.description: Top-level comment on this post (by URL). Alternative to post_id.

warnings.description: X: present when links were removed from the reply.

400.description: Missing fields, more than one target provided, Instagram without comment_id, or an unsupported platform. X: error_code `x_links_not_allowed` when the reply only contained links. TikTok: error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required` or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002).

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope.

429.description: X only: the X account reached its daily cap of replies, edits and reposts (20 on the Free plan, 200 on paid plans, per UTC day). Wait Retry-After seconds.

delete.description: Delete a comment on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn or TikTok. For LinkedIn, post_id (the post URN) is also required; TikTok deletes from comment_id alone, and only comments written by the connected account. TikTok also requires the `comments` capability (a reconnected account), or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. Also accepts POST with the same body.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete.

post_id.description: Required for LinkedIn only — the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...) the comment belongs to.

400.description: Missing fields, LinkedIn without post_id, or an unsupported platform.

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope, or you do not own the comment.

post.description: POST alias of DELETE /uploadposts/comments/delete, for clients that cannot send a body with DELETE. Same body and behavior.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete.

post_id.description: Required for LinkedIn only — the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...) the comment belongs to.

400.description: Missing fields, LinkedIn without post_id, or an unsupported platform.

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope, or you do not own the comment.

post.summary: Hide, like or pin a comment (multi-platform)
post.description: Moderate a comment on one of your own posts. One endpoint, because every action is a verb that carries its own inverse: hide/unhide, like/unlike, pin/unpin. You send the verb, never a boolean, so replaying a request can never flip a comment back. Platforms: tiktok, facebook, instagram, youtube, threads and bluesky (hide/unhide replies in the account's own threads, like/unlike); any other answers 400 `platform_not_supported`. TikTok requires the `comments` capability (a reconnected account).

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

action.description: The verb to apply. Send the inverse verb to undo it.

post_id.description: The post the comment hangs from. Required for hide, unhide, pin and unpin; do not send it for like/unlike, which resolve from the comment alone.

400.description: error_code `platform_not_supported` (only tiktok acts on comments today), `tiktok_reconnect_required` (reconnect the account), or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002: a comment that was deleted, a post_id that is not one of the account's videos, pin on a reply; retrying fails the same way).

post.description: Re-enqueue an upload that failed on one or more platforms. Only failed platforms are retried; the original media snapshot is reused, so no re-upload is needed. Provide request_id or job_id.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by the original async upload. Provide request_id or job_id.

job_id.description: The scheduled job ID. Alternative to request_id.

400.description: Neither request_id nor job_id provided.

404.description: No upload found for the given identifier.

409.description: Nothing to retry (no failed platforms).

post.description: Delete a post already published to a platform. Supported: facebook, youtube, x, linkedin, threads. Instagram and TikTok do NOT support deletion via API and return a clear error.

platform.description: Platform to delete from. Instagram and TikTok are not supported.

delete_all_messages.description: Telegram: delete every message of the post (album items, caption rest, first comment, text sent before a location...), not only post_id. Only in the chat the profile is connected to, within 48 hours. Default false. The answer lists requested_message_ids.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

post_id.description: The published post's ID on the target platform.

400.description: Missing fields or an unsupported platform (e.g. instagram, tiktok).

403.description: Not authorized to delete the post.

404.description: No post found for the given post_id.

post.description: Send a private reply (DM) to the author of a comment on your Instagram post. The comment must be less than 7 days old.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to reply to (from Get Post Comments).

buttons.description: Up to 3 web_url buttons rendered in the Instagram DM.

400.description: Missing fields or invalid account.

429.description: Daily DM limit exceeded.

get.description: Retrieve the DM conversations of the account connected to the profile, including participants and recent messages. Bluesky (platform=bluesky) needs an app password created with access to direct messages (403 bluesky_dm_scope_missing otherwise), returns at most 25 conversations per page and adds status, unread_count, muted, kind, account and per-message direction, type, attachments, reactions and reply_to. Bluesky also takes kind, lock_status, view (summary: up to 100 per page; requests: experimental) and include (unread_counts, members); group conversations add a group block. Anything Bluesky marks as under development answers with experimental: true (403 bluesky_dm_experimental_disabled while not enabled). Telegram (platform=telegram) lists only the private chats of your own bot, and needs the bot's updates turned on, which is not generally available yet (409 telegram_updates_not_enabled until then).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: 'instagram', 'bluesky' or 'telegram' (Telegram needs the bot's updates turned on).

parameters.name: business_connection_id
parameters.description: Telegram: the inbox of a connected Business account.

parameters.name: include_profile_photos
parameters.description: Telegram: add profile_pic_media_id to each contact.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Conversations per page (Bluesky: at most 25; higher values are lowered).

parameters.name: participant_id
parameters.description: Only your conversation with this person (Instagram: IGSID; Bluesky: handle or DID).

parameters.name: messages_cursor
parameters.description: Bluesky, with conversation_id: older messages of that conversation.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Bluesky: message requests only, or accepted conversations only.

parameters.name: read_state
parameters.description: Bluesky: only conversations with unread messages.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Bluesky: only direct or group conversations.

parameters.name: lock_status
parameters.description: Bluesky: only conversations with this lock status (groups).

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Bluesky: 'summary' lists up to 100 conversations with only their latest message; 'requests' (experimental) lists incoming message requests and your pending group join requests, up to 100.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Bluesky, comma-separated: 'unread_counts' adds unread_counts {accepted, request}; 'members' (with conversation_id) adds every member of that conversation.

parameters.name: members_limit
parameters.description: Bluesky, with include=members: members per page (1-100, default 50).

parameters.name: members_cursor
parameters.description: Bluesky, with include=members: paging.next_cursor of the previous members page.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters.

403.description: Bluesky: error_code bluesky_dm_scope_missing (app password without DM access).

post.description: Instagram: send a direct message to a user by IGSID; the recipient must have messaged your account first (24-hour messaging window policy enforced by Meta). Bluesky: recipient_id is a handle, DID or bsky.app profile link (or pass conversation_id); text up to 1000 characters (400 bluesky_message_too_long), up to 10 @handle mentions linked, one shared Bluesky post as attachment, reply_to, and sender_action (mark_seen, react, unreact, delete, accept, mute, unmute, leave). Buttons and templates are refused with 400. 504 bluesky_send_unconfirmed means the DM may have gone out: read the conversation before sending again. Telegram (your own bot): recipient_id is the numeric chat id; text up to 4096 characters, attachments by url or media_id (file_id), inline buttons (url or callback_data), reply_to, location, contact, business_connection_id (send as your Business account), checklist (Business), and sender_action (typing and the other chat actions, react, unreact, delete, mark_read and edit_checklist in Business chats). 403 telegram_recipient_not_started / telegram_recipient_blocked; 504 telegram_send_unconfirmed: it may have been sent.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

recipient_id.description: Instagram: IGSID of the recipient. Bluesky: handle, DID or bsky.app profile link. Required unless conversation_id is sent (Bluesky). Telegram: numeric chat id of a person (sender.id of dm_received); groups and channels are refused (telegram_private_chats_only).

message.description: The text message to send. Required unless a Bluesky post is shared or a sender_action is sent. Bluesky: up to 1000 characters.

conversation_id.description: Bluesky: send to this conversation (also group conversations).

attachments.description: Bluesky: one post to share, {"type": "post", "url": "https://bsky.app/profile/<handle>/post/<id>"} or {"type": "post", "uri": "at://..."}. Experimental: a group invitation {"type": "join_link", "code": "..."}.

reply_to.description: Bluesky: id of a message in the same conversation to reply to.

sender_action.description: Bluesky: mark_seen (mark_read), mark_all_read (every conversation; only without recipient_id / conversation_id / message; optional status), react, unreact, delete, accept, mute, unmute or leave. Does not consume the daily DM quota.

message_id.description: Bluesky: message the sender_action applies to (required for react, unreact, delete).

reaction.description: Bluesky: a single emoji for react / unreact (default ❤️).

business_connection_id.description: Telegram: send on behalf of the connected Telegram Business account.

location.description: Telegram: {latitude, longitude[, title, address]} (with title and address it is a venue).

message_ids.description: Telegram: sender_action delete for up to 100 messages.

buttons.description: Up to 3 web_url buttons rendered in the Instagram DM.

status.description: Bluesky, with sender_action=mark_all_read: only those conversations.

idempotency_key.description: Bluesky, required with messages: repeating a request with the same key returns the first answer and sends nothing again.

messages.description: Bluesky (not generally available yet: 403 bluesky_dm_batch_disabled): up to 25 DMs in one request, to existing conversations only (conversation_id). Requires idempotency_key; one batch per minute per profile; a lookup budget as large as the batch (25: one per distinct conversation, one per distinct @mention, 2 per shared post); no identical message twice to the same conversation. Each sent message counts as one DM. The response has sent, unconfirmed, failed and results[] in order; unconfirmed items come in a 200 with retryable: false.

400.description: Missing fields or invalid account. Bluesky: bluesky_message_too_long, bluesky_rejected (bluesky_error carries Bluesky's error name), or an unsupported field.

401.description: Bluesky: bluesky_reauth_required.

403.description: Bluesky: bluesky_dm_scope_missing, bluesky_recipient_unavailable (with reason), bluesky_dm_experimental_disabled or bluesky_dm_batch_disabled.

429.description: Daily DM limit exceeded, dm_rate_limited, or Bluesky: bluesky_rate_limited.

get.description: Forwards one allow-listed, read-only Bluesky method and returns Bluesky's JSON untouched in `data`. `data` is Bluesky's raw shape: if Bluesky changes its lexicon, it changes. Pass the method's own query parameters with Bluesky's names (camelCase, e.g. includePins, parentHeight); arrays by repeating the parameter or comma-separated. A parameter the method does not have answers 400 bluesky_invalid_parameter (unknown_parameters); a method outside the list answers 400 bluesky_method_not_allowed (allowed_methods). Public methods need no `user` and do not use the account's session: app.bsky.actor.getProfile, app.bsky.actor.getProfiles, app.bsky.actor.searchActors, app.bsky.actor.searchActorsTypeahead, app.bsky.feed.getActorFeeds, app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed, app.bsky.feed.getFeed, app.bsky.feed.getFeedGenerator, app.bsky.feed.getFeedGenerators, app.bsky.feed.getLikes, app.bsky.feed.getListFeed, app.bsky.feed.getPostThread, app.bsky.feed.getPosts, app.bsky.feed.getQuotes, app.bsky.feed.getRepostedBy, app.bsky.graph.getActorStarterPacks, app.bsky.graph.getFollowers, app.bsky.graph.getFollows, app.bsky.graph.getList, app.bsky.graph.getLists, app.bsky.graph.getRelationships, app.bsky.graph.getStarterPack, app.bsky.graph.getStarterPacks, app.bsky.graph.getSuggestedFollowsByActor, app.bsky.graph.searchStarterPacks, app.bsky.graph.searchStarterPacksV2, app.bsky.labeler.getServices. Account methods need `user`: app.bsky.embed.getEmbedExternalView, app.bsky.feed.searchPosts, app.bsky.feed.searchPostsV2, app.bsky.graph.getListsWithMembership, app.bsky.graph.getStarterPacksWithMembership. 15 methods read the account's private data and are not enabled on the gateway (403 bluesky_private_read_disabled): app.bsky.actor.getPreferences, app.bsky.actor.getSuggestions, app.bsky.bookmark.getBookmarks, app.bsky.feed.getActorLikes, app.bsky.feed.getTimeline, app.bsky.feed.getSuggestedFeeds, app.bsky.graph.getBlocks, app.bsky.graph.getMutes, app.bsky.graph.getListBlocks, app.bsky.graph.getListMutes, app.bsky.graph.getKnownFollowers, app.bsky.notification.getPreferences, app.bsky.notification.getUnreadCount, app.bsky.notification.listActivitySubscriptions, app.bsky.notification.listNotifications; notifications have their own /uploadposts/bluesky/notifications* endpoints and known followers /uploadposts/bluesky/followers?known=true. 47 methods in total. The birth date is never returned. With `user` and no `actor`, getProfile, getAuthorFeed, getActorFeeds, getActorStarterPacks, getFollowers, getFollows, getLists, getRelationships and getSuggestedFollowsByActor read the profile's own account. Post URIs (uri, uris) accept at:// or a bsky.app post link. limit 1-100 where Bluesky accepts it. Not available on purpose: writes, app.bsky.unspecced.*, getGroupedNotifications, chat.bsky.* (use /uploadposts/dms/*), com.atproto.*, tools.ozone.*. Successful answers are cached 60 s (notifications 30 s) on the validated parameters; public reads are shared, account reads cached per account.

parameters.name: nsid
parameters.description: Bluesky method id (see the description for the allowed list).

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Upload-Post profile username with Bluesky connected. Optional on public reads (they do not use the account's session); required on account reads.

authenticated.description: true when Bluesky answered as the connected account.

data.description: Bluesky's JSON for the method, as is (raw lexicon shape).

400.description: bluesky_invalid_parameter, bluesky_missing_parameter, bluesky_user_required, bluesky_not_connected, bluesky_rejected (Bluesky's message in error).

401.description: bluesky_reauth_required: only when Bluesky refuses the account's app password (revoked or changed); reconnect Bluesky.

403.description: bluesky_auth_required (pass user), bluesky_blocked (a block between the accounts) or bluesky_private_read_disabled (gateway: private-data method not enabled).

429.description: bluesky_rate_limited (Bluesky's limit) or bluesky_read_rate_limited (60 Bluesky reads per minute per Upload-Post account; account reads also 60 per 5 minutes and public reads 150 per 5 minutes per account). retry_after + Retry-After header.

502.description: bluesky_unavailable (Bluesky did not answer), bluesky_login_failed (temporary sign-in failure; retry in a few minutes, sign-ins for the account pause 5 minutes) or bluesky_session_unavailable (retryable).

503.description: bluesky_edge_rate_limited (retry_after 300), bluesky_read_capacity (shared ceiling reached) or bluesky_reads_disabled. Retry-After header.

post.description:
**Not generally available yet.** While webhook subscriptions are switched off for your account every route of this group answers `503` with `reason: webhook_subscriptions_disabled`.

Adds a destination that receives the listed events, besides the account webhook. Idempotent: the same url + events + profile_username returns the existing subscription (200, `created: false`) and reactivates it if it was disabled (`reactivated: true`); `name` and `source` are updated when sent. At most 10 active subscriptions per account. Team members (X-Act-As-User) cannot create them.

Deliveries carry the same body as the account webhook for that event and the same signature headers (`X-Upload-Post-Signature: sha256=HMAC(webhook_secret, "{timestamp}.{raw_body}")`, `X-Upload-Post-Timestamp`, `X-Upload-Post-Event`, `X-Upload-Post-Delivery`, `X-Upload-Post-Attempt`) plus `X-Upload-Post-Subscription: <id>`. The secret is the account webhook secret (`GET /uploadposts/users/notifications` → `notifications.webhook_secret`; created on the first subscription if missing). The first delivery can take up to about a minute; failed deliveries follow the retry schedule and appear in `GET /uploadposts/webhooks/deliveries?subscription_id=`.

events.description: Event names (dots are accepted: social_account.connected). Also youtube_video_published / youtube_video_updated and the post approval events (post_approval_requested, post_approved, post_rejected, post_approval_expired) while those features are on.
